target_customer: Secondary school students and teachers preparing for IB, SAT, ACT, AP, GCSE and A-level exams, paying as consumers, with school adoption following
problem: Students lack affordable, curriculum-specific practice and feedback; the company positions its AI platforms as an alternative to human tutors and to general chatbots.
business_model: B2C subscriptions for exam prep platforms (RevisionDojo, OnePrep, MathsGenie) with growing school and teacher use
product_category: AI exam preparation and tutoring platforms

founders.name: Bowen Liu
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no education or employers.

founders.background_notes: YC page gives no education or employers.

founders.name: Michael Tong
previous_startups: RevisionDojo (co-founder and CTO, now part of General Learning)
founders.background_notes: YC page states he is 19 at the time of the page; age at founding not stated.

competitors.name: Human tutors and ChatGPT
competitors.what: The alternatives students used for exam help, per the StudyDojo YC launch post

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM-based question practice, grading and feedback on curriculum content is standard applied AI engineering; the harder work is content quality and curriculum alignment.

defensibility.rationale: Curriculum-specific content and student progress data give some lock-in, but general chatbots and other study apps are close substitutes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General chatbots added study and tutoring modes later; no acquisition of General Learning found.

market_need_then: StudyDojo's launch post reported 2,000+ paying customers, mid-six-figure ARR, an NPS above 75 and customers in 180 countries (company claims), showing demand for exam prep among students.

branding.brand_signature: Dojo naming for the flagship product (RevisionDojo, formerly StudyDojo)
branding.community_and_virality: Company claims 140k+ community members and 2,400+ schools in the YC launch post; unverified by independent press.

brand_strength.rationale: Product brands such as RevisionDojo appear to carry the community while the parent name is generic; evidence is company claims only.

outcome_analysis: General Learning grew from the StudyDojo and RevisionDojo IB study platform into a multi-brand AI exam prep company. Its YC launch reported paying customers, mid-six-figure ARR and fast weekly growth, and it now runs about 35 people across three platforms. Funding is not confirmed by a primary source, and it is active with no exit, so the long-term outcome is open.
notes: Seedtable lists a 3.4M seed dated 14 March 2025 (page returned 403 when opened, seen only in a search snippet) and Dealroom a 125k seed with no date; single aggregators, unverified, so no round recorded. Competitor entry from the YC launch post, dated only as about 2 years before late 2026. HQ conflict Hong Kong (YC) versus San Francisco (Seedtable).
